about: Kolaboro shipping log. Every UTC day since the first commit of kolaboro.com, from the git history of the live branch (pub/_lovable), paths _s/kolaboro.com/ and the kolaboro worker modules. A ship is a commit made by a person (or by software working for one); commits by our own workflows are counted separately as data updates. Commit subjects pass a privacy filter (no project names, web addresses or emails). The full repository is private; commit ids are shown so changes can be dated. Built by GitHub Actions every hour; daily summaries are taken from the commit subjects.

streak.rule: Consecutive UTC days with at least one ship. A day with no ship yet today does not end the current streak until the day is over.

definitions.ship: A commit by a person (or by software working for one) that changes files under _s/kolaboro.com/ or _worker.js/kolaboro.js / kbx*.js on the live branch.
definitions.data_update: A commit by one of our scheduled workflows (author address @kolaboro.com), for example research data or deploy-guard records.
definitions.rollback: A commit by the deploy guard restoring files after failed smoke checks.

summary_methods.ai-checked: summary of the filtered subjects, every line mapped to commits and number-checked in code
summary_methods.deterministic: the most descriptive commit subjects of the day
summary_methods.so-far: day in progress, commit subjects so far

privacy_filter: URLs, email addresses, @handles, domains other than kolaboro.com, names and developers of tracked projects and people's names are replaced by [link], [email], [site] or [name].

deploys.source: /data/deploys.json, written by the deploy guard (GitHub Actions) after each code push to the live branch
deploys.method: A deploy counts when the guard saw the pushed commit answer on kolaboro.com/api/open/build and ran its smoke checks. "Not deployed" means the commit was not live within 12 minutes. Pushes that only change data are not guarded and not counted.

commit_to_live.source: git commit time of the deployed commit (branch pub/_lovable) and the time the deploy guard recorded it live (/data/deploys.json)
commit_to_live.method: For every passing guarded deploy: recorded time minus commit time. An upper bound: the recorded time is taken after the smoke checks, which take about a minute.

rollbacks.source: /data/deploys.json (result rolled_back or rollback_failed) and deploy-guard commits starting "roll back" on the live branch
rollbacks.method: The deploy guard rolls back the files changed since the last passing commit when the smoke checks fail twice.

workflow_runs.source: GitHub Actions API (/repos/.../actions/runs?created=<day>), workflows whose name starts with "Kolaboro"
workflow_runs.method: Every run of a kolaboro workflow (checks, data jobs, deploy guard, probes) created that UTC day, by result. Today counts runs so far. Kept for the last 21 days.

jobs.method: Schedule as written in the workflow file (cron, UTC). Last result is the conclusion of the latest run, whatever started it.

uptime_snapshot.method: Probes of the home page and the API from outside Cloudflare; the shipping page reads the live value and falls back to this snapshot.
